from.place: Proof, second paragraph: "localization and strict henselization preserve excellence"; Greco Theorem 5.3(iv) reduces this ascent assertion to Theorem 5.3(iii). In the present refinement: Weakly etale ring maps are stable under base change and composition.

title: Weakly etale ring maps are stable under base change and composition
statement: Let $A,B,C,A^{\prime}$ be commutative rings. If $A\to B$ is weakly etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra] and $A\to A^{\prime}$ is any ring map, then $A^{\prime}\to A^{\prime}\otimes_A B$ is weakly etale. If $A\to B$ and $B\to C$ are weakly etale, then their composite $A\to C$ is weakly etale.
